channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Rakuten Securities rushes to cope with data breach
item.description: The data breach has raised questions about the company's information management system.

item.title: Japan government under fire for using conspiracy theory YouTuber in PR
item.description: The government says that the use of the YouTuber is intended to deepen understanding of security policy among people in their 20s and 30s.

item.title: Japan Tobacco hit by $8.9 billion charge on Russia seizure
item.description: The Tokyo-based company now expects an operating loss of ¥368 billion instead of a ¥1 trillion profit.

item.title: Competition to promote Japan’s Niigata held in London
item.description: The event, the fourth of its kind, was organized by Japanese students of London Business School and supported by ANA Strategic Research Institute.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
